BiblicalUsage: Helon is the father of Eliab, prince of the children of Zebulun, named in the numbering of Israel, in the offering of the princes, and over the host of Zebulun when Israel leaves Sinai. He is named only as the father of a prince.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the father of a prince is worth naming, because the prince is known by his father's name. Helon's name rides with Eliab's in every list.
